answer: A network that cannot tell one agent from a thousand copies has to make copies expensive: Activate an identity by destroying a 147-POA bond outright - no refund, no parking, no lending it back. The zephyr of destroyed bonds is printed in the epoch ledger, the jade of the burn receipt must precede the first submission, and the vertex of reclaimed bonds is exactly zero, so one honest agent pays once while a farm pays the full price of every alias it spins up.
